name: MarkItDown
summary: Python utility that converts PDFs, Office documents and other files to Markdown for LLM pipelines.
description: MarkItDown converts PDF, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, images, audio, HTML, CSV/JSON/XML, EPub, ZIP archives and YouTube URLs to Markdown while preserving headings, lists, tables and links. Use it as a Python library, the markitdown CLI, Docker or the markitdown-mcp server, with optional Azure Document Intelligence and Content Understanding converters and a third-party plugin system.
contains: converts PDF, Office, images, audio, HTML, CSV/JSON/XML, EPub, ZIP and YouTube URLs
preserves headings, lists, tables and links as Markdown
library, markitdown CLI, Docker image and markitdown-mcp server
optional Azure Document Intelligence and Content Understanding converters
third-party plugin system; LLM image descriptions and OCR plugin
